items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Mike comes and tells me that I'm fired.

ctx.x: They turned that down at last. Yeah. Mike comes and tells me that I'm fired. I go over to Patterson Hotel, where Louis was, and they asked him what's the matter, Louis. I said, she'll give me a notice if I'm fired. I just stick in bed and I had a lumbago. Louis says, I put you in the band and you're going to stay in this band, I don't care what Collins said. And he and Collins had a big fuss. So I love Louis. You understand? I love Louis. I mean the reputation of being with Louis Armstrong. He lives today. People…
Maybe I can find that 15 cents for you someday.
